- Retail vertical (mid-market) — tighted conversion assumptions, some deals likely to slip into next quarter.

I highlighted the top-12 for each of you in column A of the sheet. If you disagree with my owner mapping, correct it — but please don't leave unknowns. Finance is using this for a mid-month forecast and needs clean inputs by EOD Monday.

Quick checklist (copy into your update):
- Deal name / HubSpot id
- Current stage (Proposal / Contract / Commit / Closed)
- Probability / Commit (Yes/No)
- Expected close date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- One-line risk note

Attachments: Q1_pipe_export.csv (CSV export from HubSpot)

Thanks — short updates will save us a later fire drill. I’ll review and then schedule a 15-minute commit review if we have >3 slips.
